hook.text: Engine valves used to open and close at fixed times—a compromise that limited performance.

buildup.text: Fixed timing meant the engine breathed well in only a narrow speed range, wasting potential.

discovery.text: Variable timing lets the computer shift valve events earlier or later as driving conditions change.

twist.text: Honda's VTEC switches between two cam profiles—one for efficiency and one for maximum power.

climax.text: Today nearly every engine uses variable timing to squeeze out more power and better mileage.

punchline.text: Letting valves change their schedule unlocks hidden performance.

quiz.question: What does Honda's VTEC system switch between?
